ValidationRule.description: Field Contact Made (Y/N) is required if the date first customer contact made is populated for all CLAS record types
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS - Shred', $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS – Data Management', $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS - RM'), NOT(ISBLANK( Date_First_Customer_Contact_Attempt__c)), ISPICKVAL( Contact_Made_Y_N__c , ''))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact Made (Y/N) field must be populated when Date First Customer Contact Attempt is populated.
